title: Platform - Edge
description: Edge telemetry for the application routes: native Envoy metrics per AnkiLabs and QuizLabs route (Grafana's own route left out) and the shared cloudflared tunnel. Flux delivery is on the vendored Flux Cluster Stats and Flux Control Plane dashboards. No log line is counted as a failure.

panels.title: Edge scrape targets
panels.description: Envoy and cloudflared metrics targets reachable and failed. EdgeScrapeFailed also alerts when a job has no target at all.

panels.title: Tunnel connections
panels.description: Edge connections held by the weakest cloudflared replica (normally 4).

panels.title: Route requests / s
panels.description: Requests per second Envoy sends to application route backends. AnkiLabs and QuizLabs routes only; Grafana's own route is left out.

panels.title: Route failures (15m)
panels.description: Upstream connect failures and request timeouts on application routes in the last 15 minutes. AnkiLabs and QuizLabs routes only; Grafana's own route is left out.

panels.title: Origin errors (15m)
panels.description: Requests cloudflared could not proxy to the origin in the last 15 minutes (shared tunnel).

panels.title: Edge scrape health
panels.description: Each Envoy and cloudflared metrics target over time. A gap is unknown, not healthy.

panels.title: Upstream requests by route
panels.description: Requests Envoy sent to each application route's backend in each bar (15 minutes, longer on wide ranges), stacked to the application total. A route dropping to zero while others continue points at that route or its backend. AnkiLabs and QuizLabs routes only; Grafana's own route is left out.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (envoy_cluster_name) (increase(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_total{namespace="envoy-gateway-system",envoy_cluster_name=~"httproute/(ankilabs|quizlabs)/.*"}[$__rate_interval])), "route", "$1/$2 rule $3", "envoy_cluster_name", "httproute/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/rule/([0-9]+)"), "route", "AnkiLabs API (/api)", "envoy_cluster_name", "httproute/ankilabs/ankilabs/rule/0"), "route", "AnkiLabs web (/)", "envoy_cluster_name", "httproute/ankilabs/ankilabs/rule/1"), "route", "QuizLabs API (/api)", "envoy_cluster_name", "httproute/quizlabs/quizlabs/rule/0"), "route", "QuizLabs multiplayer (/socket.io)", "envoy_cluster_name", "httproute/quizlabs/quizlabs/rule/1"), "route", "QuizLabs web (/)", "envoy_cluster_name", "httproute/quizlabs/quizlabs/rule/2")

panels.title: Route share of requests
panels.description: Each application route's share of upstream requests over the selected time range. AnkiLabs and QuizLabs routes only; Grafana's own route is left out.

panels.title: Upstream timeouts by route
panels.description: Requests Envoy gave up on because the backend did not answer within the route timeout, per route in each bar (15 minutes, longer on wide ranges). Any bar is user-visible; EdgeUpstreamFailure alerts on it. AnkiLabs and QuizLabs routes only; Grafana's own route is left out.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (envoy_cluster_name) (increase(envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_timeout{namespace="envoy-gateway-system",envoy_cluster_name=~"httproute/(ankilabs|quizlabs)/.*"}[$__rate_interval])), "route", "$1/$2 rule $3", "envoy_cluster_name", "httproute/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/rule/([0-9]+)"), "route", "AnkiLabs API (/api)", "envoy_cluster_name", "httproute/ankilabs/ankilabs/rule/0"), "route", "AnkiLabs web (/)", "envoy_cluster_name", "httproute/ankilabs/ankilabs/rule/1"), "route", "QuizLabs API (/api)", "envoy_cluster_name", "httproute/quizlabs/quizlabs/rule/0"), "route", "QuizLabs multiplayer (/socket.io)", "envoy_cluster_name", "httproute/quizlabs/quizlabs/rule/1"), "route", "QuizLabs web (/)", "envoy_cluster_name", "httproute/quizlabs/quizlabs/rule/2")

panels.title: Upstream connect failures by route
panels.description: Connections Envoy could not open to a route's backend in each bar (15 minutes, longer on wide ranges). Any bar means no ready endpoint or a refused connection; EdgeUpstreamFailure alerts on it. AnkiLabs and QuizLabs routes only; Grafana's own route is left out.

panels.title: AnkiLabs API (/api) upstream latency
panels.description: AnkiLabs API (/api) requests per Envoy upstream-time bucket and 5-minute column, in milliseconds: Envoy to backend response, not browser time. Per-endpoint latency (for example /v1/review) is in the API Gateway metrics on AnkiLabs - Service Health and AnkiLabs - AI.

panels.title: AnkiLabs web (/) upstream latency
panels.description: AnkiLabs web (/) requests per Envoy upstream-time bucket and 5-minute column, in milliseconds: Envoy to backend response, not browser time. Per-endpoint latency (for example /v1/review) is in the API Gateway metrics on AnkiLabs - Service Health and AnkiLabs - AI.

panels.title: QuizLabs API (/api) upstream latency
panels.description: QuizLabs API (/api) requests per Envoy upstream-time bucket and 5-minute column, in milliseconds: Envoy to backend response, not browser time. QuizLabs has no per-endpoint metrics; this is the finest split available.

panels.title: QuizLabs web (/) upstream latency
panels.description: QuizLabs web (/) requests per Envoy upstream-time bucket and 5-minute column, in milliseconds: Envoy to backend response, not browser time. QuizLabs has no per-endpoint metrics; this is the finest split available.

panels.title: Cloudflared edge connections per replica
panels.description: Tunnel connections each cloudflared replica holds to Cloudflare's edge: green 4, orange fewer (less redundancy), red 0 (the replica carries no traffic).

panels.title: Cloudflared origin proxy errors (shared)
panels.description: Requests cloudflared could not proxy to the origin, per pod and bar. Shared by every application; check Envoy and the cloudflared logs at the bottom.

panels.title: Cloudflared responses by status (shared)
panels.description: HTTP responses cloudflared returned per status code in each bar, stacked to the tunnel total. Shared by every application behind the tunnel, so it cannot be split per application.

panels.title: Cloudflared status code share (shared)
panels.description: Share of each HTTP status cloudflared returned over the selected time range.

panels.title: Envoy application route errors and slow requests
panels.description: Access records of application routes that returned 5xx, carry an Envoy response flag (no upstream, reset, timeout) or were slow: 30 s or more on AnkiLabs API (AI calls normally take 10-20 s), 2 s or more on the other routes (QuizLabs multiplayer is long-lived by design and shows only on errors). Grafana's route, records without an application route (such as health checks) and fast successful requests are left out. Records carry route names, never paths or queries.

targets.expr: {namespace="envoy-gateway-system",app="envoy"} | json | event="edge.request.completed" | upstream_cluster=~"httproute/(ankilabs|quizlabs)/.+" | http_status >= 500 or response_flags != "-" or (duration_ms >= 30000 and upstream_cluster = "httproute/ankilabs/ankilabs/rule/0") or (duration_ms >= 2000 and upstream_cluster !~ "httproute/(ankilabs/ankilabs/rule/0|quizlabs/quizlabs/rule/1)") | line_format `{{ if eq .upstream_cluster "httproute/ankilabs/ankilabs/rule/0" }}AnkiLabs API (/api){{ else if eq .upstream_cluster "httproute/ankilabs/ankilabs/rule/1" }}AnkiLabs web (/){{ else if eq .upstream_cluster "httproute/quizlabs/quizlabs/rule/0" }}QuizLabs API (/api){{ else if eq .upstream_cluster "httproute/quizlabs/quizlabs/rule/1" }}QuizLabs multiplayer (/socket.io){{ else if eq .upstream_cluster "httproute/quizlabs/quizlabs/rule/2" }}QuizLabs web (/){{ else }}{{ regexReplaceAll "httproute/([^/]+)/([^/]+)/rule/([0-9]+)" .upstream_cluster "$1/$2 rule $3" }}{{ end }} {{ .http_status }} {{ .method }} {{ .duration_ms }} ms{{ if ne .response_flags "-" }} flags={{ .response_flags }}{{ end }}`

panels.title: Envoy runtime logs
panels.description: Envoy's own records (configuration, listener and upstream warnings), not access records; they stay raw with severity UNKNOWN and are not failure counts.

panels.title: Cloudflared logs
panels.description: Raw cloudflared logs: tunnel connection changes and origin errors. Shared by every application; not a failure count.
